title: Mechanism Shift During Post-training from Autoregressive to Masked Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2601.14758v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Post-training pretrained autoregressive models (ARMs) into masked diffusion models (MDMs) provides an efficient route to diffusion language modeling, but it remains unclear whether the resulting models reuse inherited autoregressive computation or reorganize it for non-autoregressive generation. We compare two 7B ARM-MDM families across four controlled diagnostic tasks and find a task-dependent mechanism shift. On prefix-dominant tasks, MDMs largely preserve inherited high-attribution pathways or exhibit only modest changes in where computation occurs. On globally constrained tasks, the reorganization is substantially stronger, with task-relevant computation shifting toward earlier layers. This depth-wise pattern persists across prompt resampling, circuit budgets, and tested inference budgets, while targeted ablations support the functional importance of the identified structures under the tested intervention protocols. translated_title: 从自回归到掩码扩散语言模型后训练过程中的机制转变
translated_abstract: 将预训练的自回归模型（ARM）后训练为掩码扩散模型（MDM）为扩散语言建模提供了一条高效路径，但目前尚不清楚由此得到的模型是复用继承下来的自回归计算，还是将其重组以实现非自回归生成。我们在四个受控诊断任务上比较了两个 7B 规模的 ARM-MDM 模型家族，发现存在一种依赖于任务的机制转变。在前缀主导型任务上，MDM 基本保留了继承的高归因通路，或仅在计算发生的位置上表现出适度变化。在全局约束型任务上，重组则显著更强，任务相关计算向更早的层转移。这种沿深度分布的模式在提示重采样、电路预算以及所测试的推理预算下均持续存在，同时针对性消融实验在所测试的干预协议下支持了所识别结构的功能重要性。
tldr: 该研究发现，将自回归语言模型后训练为掩码扩散模型时会发生依赖任务的机制转变：在前缀主导任务上模型基本保留继承的自回归计算通路，而在全局约束任务上计算会显著重组并前移至更早的层。
en_tdlr: Post-training autoregressive models into masked diffusion models induces a task-dependent mechanism shift, largely preserving inherited autoregressive computation on prefix-dominant tasks while substantially reorganizing computation toward earlier layers on globally constrained tasks.
